annotatedSteps.description: Correct chemical formulae of reactants and products

annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Equation is not balanced (LHS has 2 H atoms, RHS has 3 H atoms)

teacherNote: Marked against: Writing the correct chemical formulae of reactants and products (0.5); Balancing the chemical equation (2Na + 2H₂O → 2NaOH + H₂) (0.5); Stating the type of reaction (Displacement reaction / Redox / Exothermic) (1). Good job identifying the correct products and naming the reaction type as a displacement reaction. However, always count the number of atoms on both sides to ensure the equation is balanced: it should be 2Na + 2H₂O → 2NaOH + H₂.
